title: Docker Basics Every Developer Should Know
intro: Docker packages your app with everything it needs, so it runs the same on every machine.

slides.heading: Image vs Container
slides.subtitle: The recipe vs the running dish.
points: Image: a read-only template of your app
Container: a running copy of an image
One image can start many containers

slides.heading: Dockerfile
slides.subtitle: The instructions for building an image.
examples: FROM node:20 for a Node.js app

slides.heading: Key commands
slides.subtitle: The four you'll use daily.
points: docker build -t app . builds an image
docker compose up starts multi-container apps

cta: Have you containerized a project yet?
